visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with hair in a bun wears a strapless, voluminous metallic silver and gold gown in a photography studio. She poses against a minimalist grey and yellow backdrop while a male photographer in black captures shots. Studio lights and reflectors are visible in the background. (2) Behind-the-scenes footage shows the woman getting ready, traveling in a car while chatting cheerfully, and having her hair styled by an assistant in a tented backstage area. (3) The woman sits at a wooden table for an interview, gesturing actively. A young boy wearing glasses and a grey blazer appears, looking toward someone off-camera in a hallway. (4) The woman boards a black van branded with 'Caravelle' and 'Golden Bell 60' logos. She arrives at a red carpet event under bright outdoor lights, waving and smiling at photographers and fans. (5) Inside a grand theater, the woman sits in the front row of the audience. She looks up toward the balcony, waving excitedly to family members. Close-up shots show her emotional reaction, tearing up and dabbing her eyes with a tissue. (6) A transition shows the award ceremony stage with two presenters opening an envelope. Later, at a post-ceremony dinner, the woman stands near a table displaying multiple gold trophies. (7) A closing montage features clips of the woman practicing in a rehearsal room with others, eating a meal with a production crew, and playing in a park, ending with her waving goodbye to the camera.
